title: Fish SMP Modpack
description: small modpack put together for Fish SMP, hope you enjoy!
body:
a modpack put together for Fish SMP, here's what comes from the mods and resource packs included!

## Proximity Voice Chat
When nearby other players, you can talk as if in a voice call! But walk too far away, and their voice will get quieter until you can't hear them- so you'll have to stay close! (Normal text chat is still available) 
![shows players talking with speakers beside their usernames, one of them is muted](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/9eGKb6K1/images/d29a64a23694cd2346aabb94bea25245b7198553.png)
## Revive your friends within a short time if they go down
When you run out of health, instead of dying, you will go "down" for a short time, where other players can revive you! The bigger the party you're playing with, the more likely of being able to recover from downs you'll be. Also helps prevent annoying freak deaths that you could have done nothing to stop- huzzah! 
![someone knocked out with a message saying "107 seconds left to be rescued"](https://wsrv.nl/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fblay09.net%2Ffiles%2Fbrand%2Fhardcorerevival.png&n=-1)
## Cook food to help you & your friends!
Four new crops to find and grow. A stove, pot, pan, knife, cutting board. New food from Smoked Ham & Melon Juice, to Squid Ink Pasta & Shepard's Pie! A lot of the new foods give temporary buffs to aid in your adventures, so make sure to stock up before going out! 
![farmer's delight kitchenware](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/R2OftAxM/images/abbdd61b7ad127fdf039742363f923507cd6ddef.png)
![the 4 crops that farmer's delight adds](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/R2OftAxM/images/5116e753d281d7314e14d9c9fe9d043983861406.png)
![the meals that farmer's delight adds](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/R2OftAxM/images/f200944fad13f6afe5e16b6f75b8c4d947667cd8.png)
## Ender Dragon drops an Elytra
No more needing to worry about coming in too late and missing all the fun and having a hard time getting elytra, just respawn the dragon and slay it!
![ender dragon dying and dropping an elytra](https://github.com/Serilum/.cdn/raw/main/projects/dragon-drops-elytra/a.jpg)
## Immersive coordinates and time, and new map
The usual way players get world coordinates (the debug menu) has been removed in favor of HUD elements that appear when you have a compass in your inventory. There is also a world map that fills out as you explore, press [y] to view it! 
![coordinate and time of day overlays while having a compass and clock in your inventory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/PKoLkD98/images/807a378765cc7452e43a22593fb0898663fb7784.png)
![xaero's world map](https://wsrv.nl/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fchocolateminecraft.com%2Fimages%2Fworldmapbanner.png&n=-1)
## Easy magic/anvil, tax free levels
Experience levels are easier to get, reroll enchantments for a small cost, renaming items is free and xp repar cost with an anvil doesn't get more expensive. Enchant, repair, name, and customize your gear much easier! 
![floating items, look at it, so pretty!](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Fuzss/modresources/main/pages/data/easymagic/media/1.png)
![reroll button, one click to get all new enchantments](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Fuzss/modresources/main/pages/data/easymagic/media/2.png)
![fancy anvils, see what you've left inside!](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Fuzss/modresources/main/pages/data/easyanvils/media/1.png)
## Immersive interfaces, lootr
Beautiful pixel art UI for most interfaces, and naturally spawning chests from structures will have unique loot for each player, so no need to worry about finding already looted chests! 
![immersive interfaces resource pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/abed9b1f336d06deb0b05235c25e26230855ba29.png)
![naturally spawned lootr chest](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/EltpO5cN/images/8f47f895d5a50480c6cdf8371c622c7df05c265b.png)
## Fancy crops, Angel's weather, 3d skin layers, performance mods
crop variation, beautiful and calm rain sounds, skins are 3d, improved performance!
![fancy crops resource pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/UGEVQ6t9/images/1ab4422225a47fd6c9e3012fa59e34e4842b2eeb.jpeg)
![3d skin layers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tr7zw/3d-Skin-Layers/1.19/img/MC_NU_HEADER.png)
![sodium](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/AANobbMI/images/5ca2e8f6c72f3d543dd3dc95b706964c5678d80e.png)
